assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) is the arithmetic average of the two tests: 0.50 * test1 + 0.5 * test2, or 100% of the Resit Exam grade. To pass, the final grade must be equal to or greater than 9.5 out of 20. Students can recover one test score on the Resit Exam date. Prior registration is mandatory for the Resit Exam, to be done on the course page up to one week before the exam.
